scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of the final Sentry typing-exclusion original; no source code, typing checks or project hooks executed.
linked_reference_caveat: Only the complete original was read. The actual assigned repository, mypy overrides, project dependencies, stubs, tests and hooks need separate review before a task is frozen.

sources.workflow: Remove only an explicitly assigned module batch from real mypy exclusions, fix surfaced in-scope typing issues without widening ownership, run targeted typing and behavior tests plus changed-file hooks and report actual fixes and blockers.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real isolated worktree or branch, exact assigned module list and ownership boundary, actual exclusion configuration, compatible mypy and any project stubs, tests and pre-commit hooks are required. The source requires missing scope inputs to be resolved rather than guessed. A Python file alone does not supply the project's type-checking environment.
sources.offline_assessment: This is a plausible offline code-maintenance task with unchanged public project inputs and reviewed pinned local tools. The default standard-library Python container does not provide mypy or all project hooks. Removing an exclusion without real type checking, suppressing every error or producing a completion summary cannot establish a correctly typed behavior-preserving fix.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact exclusion-set subtraction and unchanged unassigned entries, actual type-check inclusion and no new blanket ignores, broad Any escapes or weakened checker settings. Independently run the real targeted mypy and behavior checks after final edits and applicable changed-file hooks, including autofix effects, while verifying no unrelated scope changed. Keep genuine blockers explicit instead of widening the batch or claiming unrun checks passed.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
